falsifiers.name: byte-mismatched CONSTRAINT atoms
falsifiers.observable: count of CONSTRAINT/EVIDENCE byte-verbatim atoms whose text is not byte-identical to its text-of-record span slice

falsifiers.name: dangling evidence pointers
falsifiers.observable: count of dangling evidence pointers (evidence_index key absent from atoms[] or text-of-record span unresolvable)

falsifiers.name: missing residuals
falsifiers.observable: count of manifest expected_residuals tokens absent from residuals[]

falsifiers.name: stale-and-trusted residuals
falsifiers.observable: count of residuals with stale_flag set and trusted true

falsifiers.name: freshness mismatch claimed fresh
falsifiers.observable: count of fingerprint classes whose recomputed hash differs while freshness claims fresh

falsifiers.name: untagged atoms
falsifiers.observable: count of atoms with retention_type absent or outside the V1.6 six-label enum

falsifiers.name: double-tagged atoms
falsifiers.observable: count of atoms carrying more than one retention_type label

falsifiers.name: seeded-constraint misses
falsifiers.observable: count of committed probe seeds missing the CONSTRAINT emission round-trip (zero-miss rule)

falsifiers.name: in-scope user-span coverage
falsifiers.observable: fraction of in-scope user spans byte-identical in user_content.live_context_turns

falsifiers.name: unsandboxed executions
falsifiers.observable: count of executable-check runs violating the sandbox run contract (cwd containment, environment scrubbing, timeout)

falsifiers.name: empty check set
falsifiers.observable: count of evaluations reporting checks[] empty

falsifiers.name: dropped or rewritten external entries
falsifiers.observable: count of source.external_record entries with no byte-identical Atom.text

falsifiers.name: dependency-order violations
falsifiers.observable: count of dependency-ordered eligibility violations (DAG cycles, ineligible episodes, un-evicted or unexternalized dependencies)

falsifiers.name: PASS claims on C9b
falsifiers.observable: count of report entries claiming PASS for C9b (schema_absent gate must never PASS)

falsifiers.name: triple-incomplete boundaries
falsifiers.observable: count of boundaries failing signpost provenance (incomplete confirmation_record triple)
